name: Beipiaosaurus
sum: Early therizinosaur from the Yixian Formation of China, among the largest dinosaurs with direct evidence of feathers.
holotype: Partial skeleton found by a farmer in 1996, Yixian Formation, Liaoning, China (Xu et al. 1999).
material: Three reported specimens with numerous feather impressions.
exceptional: Feather impressions, including an unusual elongated broad filament type (Xu et al. 2009), and melanosomes (Li et al. 2014).
biology: Had a shorter neck than most therizinosaurs; its body was covered in filaments with longer broad feathers.
author: Xu et al. 1999
